package.name: sas_legged_client_window
package.description: Qt window to monitor and command a legged robot driver of sas_tools (mode, twist, base pose, limbs), with an emergency stop and a watchdog. It uses LeggedRobotDriverClient and RobotDriverClient, so it works with any legged robot that follows the standard. Requires Qt 6 (qt6-base-dev).
